featured_reviews.name: AMBUJ SRIVASTAVA
featured_reviews.review_text: We were struggling to find an interior designer who would understand our vision and requirement. Every one we met with just copied and pasted templates from their earlier assignments. That's when we heard about Juhi and her firm RLAD through an acquaintance who had availed their services. Our first meeting was enough to know we had finally found someone who understood our preferences. Juhi's designs brought modern, minimalist aesthetics without compromising on functional aspects. She patiently went through multiple design iterations with us till we landed on something we were happy with. She guided us through every step of the way, from selecting laminates, wallpapers, lights and fabrics. Thanks to her, we have a home we love and feel proud of. I would recommend her and RLAD in a heartbeat.

featured_reviews.name: Vishnu Khatri
featured_reviews.review_text: We have got our Home designed by Raj bhai and team and i would say they are just perfect planner! What we liked the most is that we got our Home designed which is a much better version of what we have visualized or thought of. What i like most was Juhi ji's clarity  on choosing Door Handles, Accessories, Wall Color Paints etc. Since she was able to Forsee what will work and elevate our home and what will not. They are really thoughful curator.

featured_reviews.name: Aman Chheda
featured_reviews.review_text:
Raj’s passion for his work is truly unmatched. His obsession with design and his commitment to exceeding client expectations is extraordinary. When I was in the US, our building redevelopment in India was completed, and we were on the hunt for an interior designer. After receiving outrageous quotes from several designers—both in terms of cost and timelines (over a year!)—I wasn’t feeling very good.

That’s when Raj stepped in. He offered to visit the space with my parents, take notes on our requirements, and understand my thoughts through a series of video calls. Without any commitment from our side, he took a couple of days and sent us designs that were impressive. Fast forward 5 months—his work was efficient, structured, and beyond what we had imagined. He transformed a 900 sq ft apartment into a paradise that my parents and I love coming home to.

Even after two years, my mom and dad are as obsessed as they were on day 1. Whenever guests visit, my mom calls me later that night to tell me how much they loved the place. I could go on and on about the amazing experience we had with Raj, but instead, I’ll let the photos speak for themselves.

It’s clear that when you prioritize quality and customer satisfaction over everything else, the results are outstanding. Raj and his team are the perfect example of this. If you’re reading this review, take it as a sign to contact Raj immediately. You won’t regret it.

Good luck, Raj!

featured_reviews.name: Megha Yadava
featured_reviews.review_text: Raj’s work is truly exceptional—thoughtful, detail-oriented, and deeply client-focused. Every space he designs reflects not just aesthetic excellence but also a clear understanding of functionality and the client’s vision. From concept to execution, Raj is hands-on and meticulous, ensuring that no detail is overlooked. He is easy to communicate with, open to feedback, and always willing to go the extra mile to bring ideas to life. If you’re looking for an architectural and interior design firm in Mumbai that blends creativity with precision, Raj and his team are a fantastic choice.

featured_reviews.name: Tejas Hatalkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Raj Lakhani & his team were fabulous. We had started the Design well ahead. Raj & team were patient enough to understand our needs, requirements, constraints. They arranged for multiple discussions & were always open to modify their designs as per our needs.

Overall , we had a fantastic experience working with them & we are thankful for a very successful Project delivered by them.

featured_reviews.name: Tanvi Chimbaikar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Exceptional Experience with Aumkara – Highly Recommended!
We recently completed the interiors of our 1.5 BHK home in Lower Parel with Aumkara, and the entire experience was truly exceptional. After exploring and shortlisting multiple designers, we chose them based on the clarity we felt during our initial discussions — and it turned out to be the best decision we could have made for our home.
What sets Aumkara apart is their beautiful balance of professionalism and warmth. They bring structure and expertise to the process while making you feel completely heard and understood. We genuinely enjoyed being part of the journey — from conceptualization and design discussions to material selection — and learned so much along the way.
Their execution is remarkable. The transition from 3D designs to the final outcome was almost flawless — nearly a 99% match. That level of precision speaks volumes about their commitment to quality.
They are incredibly patient listeners, but what we appreciated even more was their confidence in guiding us. They weren’t afraid to say “no” when certain ideas didn’t align with the overall vision of the space — and in hindsight, that honesty elevated the final result beautifully.
The most special part of the journey was the trust we built. During moments when I felt overwhelmed or unsure, I leaned entirely on their instincts and integrity. Whether it was choosing hardware like door knobs, finalizing the color palette, or designing the Mandir, their selections turned out to be thoughtful, tasteful, and far better than what I would have chosen myself.
From a project management perspective, everything was handled with impressive discipline. Timelines were respected, the budget was carefully managed, and transparency was maintained at every stage. We were consistently informed about design updates and material choices, which gave us complete peace of mind.
Working with Aumkara has been a rewarding and joyful experience. They didn’t just design our house — they helped us create a home we truly love and feel connected to. Thank you Omkar and Alshifa for helping our dream come true.
